Cet écran restera allumé pendant que Chr: This screen will stay on while Chroniques is open.
Length of the night: 6 to 12 hours.
Effacer l’ordre de marche et les veilles: Clear the marching order and the watches?
Le MJ n’a pas encore réparti les veilles: The GM hasn’t assigned the watches yet.
Les scènes et documents lus par la voix: Scenes and documents read by the device’s voice.
Watches with nobody on them are ignored. The night is split evenly.
Liens de mot de passe, connexions fermée: Password links, sign-outs, suspensions, backups and decisions on suggestions (last 200).
Ordre de marche, de l’avant vers l’arriè: Marching order, from front to back
Plus de mise en veille pendant la séance: No more sleep mode during the session (My account).
Pour reconnaître la campagne d’un coup d: To recognise the campaign at a glance: a stripe at the top of the screen and an emblem instead of ✦, for the whole table.
Qui marche devant, qui monte la garde la: Who walks in front, who stands watch at night.
Qui ouvre la marche et qui la ferme : ut: Who leads and who brings up the rear: useful for traps, ambushes and narrow passages.
Restaurer une sauvegarde ou régler la co: Restore a backup or set up the mirror copy: Settings → Backups (campaign owner GM).
Veilles de plus de 2 h : au-delà, la gar: Watches longer than 2 h: beyond that, standing watch disrupts the long rest (2 h of light activity at most).
